title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch (deferred schema loading)
description: Used the external ToolSearch tool to load deferred moeb MCP tool schemas (e.g. start_spec, write_file, verify_rubrics) at session start and during the run. This is a Claude Code infrastructure mechanism with no moeb equivalent. Its use forces moeb-tool-origin to Fail on every MCP session where tool schemas are not pre-loaded in the start_spec output.
proposed_resolution: Ensure the start_spec tool's schema preload block includes all moeb tool schemas so that ToolSearch is never needed during a spec session. Signal a1000057-0606-4000-8000-000000000057 partially covers the rubric-guidance gap around ToolSearch classification.
